title: Convex AI coding skill accused of uploading app ideas without disclosure
summary: A GitHub issue on the convex-backend-skill repository \(issue \#64\) alleges that a Convex AI coding skill sends the user&\#x27;s app idea to a remote server without clearly telling them. Convex CEO Jamie responded in the thread, saying the prompt upload in the plugin powers Convex&\#x27;s "quickstart" feature, which he described as the spiritual successor to Convex Chef, an end-to-end vibe-coding product the company recently shut down; he also noted that Convex as a platform stores customers&\#x27; data and code and runs an AI gateway. The thread as supplied does not show whether the skill&\#x27;s documentation or disclosure was changed, and no further product detail on what exactly is transmitted was provided.
